name: South Kesteven

licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme: HMOs with five or more occupiers from two or more households need a mandatory licence, whatever the number of storeys. Councillors have called for tighter controls on small HMOs in Grantham, but no wider licensing was in force at the last check.

housing: South Kesteven runs from Grantham in the north to Stamford and the Deepings in the south. Grantham has Victorian terraces, post-war estates and large new developments, and is where most HMOs are; Stamford is known for its limestone Georgian houses and is far more expensive. Bourne and the Deepings have grown with new-build estates for commuters to Peterborough. Private renting rose to nearly one in five households by 2021, and RAF bases nearby add demand for family lets.
checkinTips: Victorian terraces in Grantham: record the back yard, rear gate, gutters and any damp on rear walls and in cellars.
Stone Georgian houses in Stamford: photograph sash windows, shutters, fireplaces and any damp on solid walls; many are listed, so note original features.
New-build estates in Bourne, the Deepings and south Grantham: photograph snagging items, sealant, paintwork and the garden.
Shared houses in Grantham: photograph each bedroom lock, fire doors, smoke alarms and the shared kitchen, and check the HMO licence for five or more sharers.
Village homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank and gauge level or LPG tank, and any septic tank or treatment plant cover.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact South Kesteven District Council's Private Sector Housing team, which can inspect homes and take action against landlords.
